concepts.label: EngineeringActivity
concepts.definition: The root of the activity vocabulary: one thing an agent did to a software artifact.

concepts.label: Inspection
concepts.definition: Reading a software artifact without changing it.

concepts.label: Search
concepts.definition: Locating artifacts or occurrences by a query rather than by name.

concepts.label: ArtifactEvaluation
concepts.definition: Running a check that returns a verdict on an artifact — a test suite, a linter, a type checker.

concepts.label: ScriptExecution
concepts.definition: Running a program for its effect rather than for a verdict on an artifact.

concepts.label: Checkin
concepts.definition: Committing a change into the configuration management repository.

concepts.label: Checkout
concepts.definition: Retrieving a version or its history from the configuration management repository.

concepts.label: EnvironmentConfiguration
concepts.definition: Preparing what a build or a run depends on — dependencies, tooling, settings.

concepts.label: NetworkRetrieval
concepts.definition: Fetching an artifact or a document from outside the project.

concepts.label: Delegation
concepts.definition: Handing a unit of work to another agent, which performs its own sequence.

concepts.label: SoftwareProcess
concepts.definition: The root of the prompt-level vocabulary: what one user turn was for.

concepts.label: BugFix
concepts.definition: A prompt whose goal is to correct behaviour that is already wrong.

concepts.label: FeatureAddition
concepts.definition: A prompt whose goal is a capability the system does not have yet.

concepts.label: Enhancement
concepts.definition: A prompt whose goal is to improve existing behaviour rather than add a capability.

concepts.label: Investigation
concepts.definition: A prompt whose goal is understanding rather than change.

concepts.label: Documentation
concepts.definition: A prompt whose goal is to write or revise documentation.

concepts.label: ReleaseManagement
concepts.definition: A prompt whose goal is to version, package or publish the system.

concepts.label: Unknown
concepts.definition: No rule determined an activity class or a process type. A member of both vocabularies and a root of neither: what is kept whole, and counted, so it can be reclassified without re-ingesting.

relations.label: followedBy
relations.definition: A permissible transition between procedures, evidenced by at least one episodic sequence.

relations.label: subClassOf
relations.definition: The coarser procedure identity that a finer one specialises.

relations.label: supportedBy
relations.definition: The episodic steps that evidence an abstract transition.
